_readme: sh-ZW normaliser test spec — SEPARATE from the frozen normaliser_tests.json.
Amounts are integer CENTS (USD): 'five dollars fifty' = 550.
PROVENANCE: utterances drafted by an AI assistant from the pcm-yo-NG case
pattern and CORRECTED by a native Shona speaker on 2026-09-02 (see
packs/sh-ZW-recording-script.md). Texts below are her corrected wording
verbatim (punctuation dropped; 'Zvinyre' kept as she typed it).
Her recordings of these same sentences become the frozen sh-ZW audio tier;
the pack does not ship until those clips pass.

Ndatengesa one bag rechibage ne forty five dollars
cases.note: 'forty five dollars' multiplies to cents; item keeps her concord form

cases.note: no verb trigger — unit anchors it, like pcm case 7

ndatenga (bought) vs ndatengesa (sold) — distinct tokens; glued YEten

cases.note: leading 'bag' binds as the unit; 'maplastic bags' survives as the item

cases.note: chandatengesa is a different token from ndatengesa — no false sale
